notes: Fiscal 2026 ended January 30, 2026 (Dell's own label; matches data.js fy 'Jan 2026'). Filings: Fiscal 2026 Form 10-K (accession 0001571996-26-000008, filed March 16, 2026) and 2026 proxy statement (accession 0001193125-26-226734), both read on www.sec.gov. MICHAEL DELL (founder, Chairman and CEO): the 40.9% is stated by the proxy in its 'Percentage Ownership of All Outstanding Dell Technologies Common Stock' column, so no derivation is needed; it is down from 41.4% a year earlier as his Class C holding fell from 36,335,779 to 18,840,608 shares. It includes 2,682,335 Class C shares held by the Michael & Susan Dell Foundation and excludes the SLD Trust's 4.8% (Susan Dell's trust, of which the proxy says Mr. Dell 'may be deemed the beneficial owner'); the trust is listed separately as a family holder, so the two don't overlap. pctVoting is null because the proxy gives no voting-power percentage for him alone; the 91.7% in the 10-K covers MD and SLP stockholders combined. HOLDERS by size: SLP 7.4% (Silver Lake converted and sold Class B during the year), SLD Trust 4.8%, BlackRock 3.5% (22,819,963 Class C shares); Vanguard Capital Management, also 3.5% with 22,512,097 shares (13G filed April 29, 2026, as of March 31, 2026), is left out by the three-holder limit. Silver Lake's asOf uses the proxy table date because it relies on a March 2026 13D/A plus later Form 4s; the SLD Trust and BlackRock figures rest on 2023 and 2024 reports. BUYBACKS exclude $390 million of repurchases for employee tax withholdings. STOCK COMP: $723 million (cash-flow add-back; the XBRL note value is also 723).
